title: Lorentz regauging of Maxwell's quaternions

tellings.quote: back in the late early 1900s, Heinrich Lorentz, he did something that was called symmetrical regauging of Maxwell's quaternions, because Maxwell

plain: In the early 1900s, the physicist Hendrik Lorentz did something called a "symmetrical regauging" of the equations of James Clerk Maxwell, which Maxwell had written in quaternions, a four-part number system, and in doing so is said to have changed what physics kept from them. A man named Dave Rossi, who says on the show that he learned advanced physics from aliens, tells Michels this without naming a source, calling Lorentz "Heinrich". The point of the story is that something in Maxwell's original theory may have been set aside.
